# UK may be speared from Trump tariffs

- Trump indicated he is working on a UK trade deal that could exempt Britain from tariffs
- Called Starmer a "tough negotiator" who is trying to persuade him against imposing tariffs on Britain
- Trump's UK comments came after threatening 25% tariffs on EU exports and confirming tariffs on Mexico, Canada, and China
- Trump described the UK as "a very different place" from the EU
- The leaders failed to reach agreement on US security guarantees for Ukraine
